purpose: Test whether the Official Statistics of Finland monthly industrial roundwood table supplies a stable public product-level price-and-volume cell suitable for a future BPM physical-market jurisdiction.

deterministic_selection_after_metadata.month: exactly 2026-07 if present; otherwise stop NOT_ESTIMABLE_TARGET_MONTH_ABSENT
deterministic_selection_after_metadata.price_region: whole country or exact English equivalent; otherwise stop NOT_ESTIMABLE_NO_NATIONAL_CELL
deterministic_selection_after_metadata.type_of_sale: standing sales or exact English equivalent; otherwise stop NOT_ESTIMABLE_NO_STANDING_SALE
deterministic_selection_after_metadata.roundwood_assortment: spruce logs or exact English equivalent; otherwise stop NOT_ESTIMABLE_NO_SPRUCE_LOG_CELL
information: transaction or purchase volume in a physical cubic-metre unit
nominal unit price in EUR per cubic metre

prohibitions: no payment, terms acceptance or contact with source owners
no product, month, region or sale-type substitution after seeing values
no claim that one Finland cell generalizes to Spain, Argentina, Eurostat STS, AEAT or RMK
no use of current values as a pre-release causal forecast
